The two families still enumerated by date are the two that bit today.
reader_dated_slot_defect_20260817.recommended_fix: Resolve NOVELTY_VERDICT_KEYS and NEXT_GATE_COST_KEYS by dated PATTERN, newest first, undated last -- i.e. the same treatment _DATED_LIFECYCLE and _DATED_LIFECYCLE_WHY already received on 2026-08-17. Per the file's own reasoning this is safe for GATES and COSTS (a newer gate still has to pass _is_unspec; a newer cost still has to state what the NEXT step costs) and unsafe only for BLOCKERS, which is why blockers use discharge pointers instead.
